''Zeleni'' (The Greens) | founded = {{Start date and years ago|df=yes|1922|05|11}}{{cite web | url = https://www.nzs.si/tekmovanja/?action=vsiKlubi&id_menu=35 | title = Klubi |trans-title=Clubs | publisher = [[Football Association of Slovenia]] | access-date = 29 July 2016 | language = sl }} | ground = [[Matija Gubec Stadium]] | capacity = 1,470 | chrtitle = President | chairman = Jože Tomažin | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Adnan Zildžović]] | league = [[Slovenian Second League]] | season = [[2025–26 Slovenian Second League#League table|2025–26]] | position = Slovenian Second League, 14th of 16 | pattern_la1= | pattern_b1= | pattern_ra1= | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1= 62CB55 | body1= 62CB55 | rightarm1= 62CB55 | shorts1= 074E3E | socks1= 074E3E | pattern_la2= | pattern_b2= | pattern_ra2= | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2=FFFFFF | body2=FFFFFF | rightarm2=FFFFFF | shorts2=FFFFFF | socks2=FFFFFF | website= {{URL|https://nkkrskoposavje.si/}} }} '''Nogometni klub Krško Posavje''' ({{langx|en|Krško Posavje Football Club}}), commonly referred to as '''NK Krško Posavje''' or simply '''Krško Posavje''', is a Slovenian [[Association football|football]] club from [[Krško]] that competes in the [[Slovenian Second League]], the second tier of Slovenian football. The club was founded in 1922. Their home ground is the [[Matija Gubec Stadium]] with a capacity to accommodate 1,470 spectators. In 2023, the club merged with NK Posavje Krško and was renamed NK Krško Posavje.{{cite web |title=NK Krško Posavje za začetek nove nogometne zgodbe v Krškem |url=https://www.posavskiobzornik.si/nogomet/nk-krsko-posavje-za-zacetek-nove-nogometne-zgodbe-v-krskem-100961 |website=Posavski obzornik |access-date=16 August 2023 |language=sl |date=27 July 2023}}"}}
